comment: Bandit arms: design directions Bob explores. An arm is a mechanism-family bet, not a theme. The scholar loop and meta loop may ADD arms; only a human removes one. Reward01 fed to the bandit = final game score / 100, or 0.15 for a kill before publish (learning still happened), plus post-publish market bonus applied retroactively.

gravity-physics.hook: gravity/balance/tipping as the referee — physics resolves what dice used to
gravity-physics.print_edge: cantilevers, weighted cams, tuned tipping points impossible in cardboard

hidden-mechanism.hook: a printed black-box mechanism holds hidden state — the game is interrogating it
hidden-mechanism.print_edge: internal channels, one-way gates, marble memories no player can see

interlock-legality.hook: the pieces' physical geometry IS the rulebook — illegal moves don't fit
interlock-legality.print_edge: edge keying, registration pins, shape grammars

kinetic-timer.hook: a running mechanism (escapement, flow, unwinding) is the shared clock/pressure

measurement-dexterity.hook: measuring, estimating, or placing under physical tolerance — skill you can feel
measurement-dexterity.print_edge: gauge pieces, tolerance ladders, calibrated wobble

modular-worldbuild.hook: the board is built/rebuilt during play from printed modules; topology is the strategy
modular-worldbuild.print_edge: connectors, ramps, 3D adjacency cardboard can't do

asymmetric-machine.hook: one player IS the machine/system, others play against or through it
asymmetric-machine.print_edge: the machine player gets a physical console/mechanism others can't touch

legacy-permanence.hook: permanent physical change across plays — pieces that wear, lock, or combine forever
legacy-permanence.print_edge: printed parts are cheap enough to consume; cardboard legacy games fake this

classic-reborn.hook: an original sculptural/physical edition of a public-domain classic (chess, xiangqi, go, mancala, backgammon, nine men's morris) — the game is proven, the object is the invention
classic-reborn.print_edge: themed sets, integrated storage, mechanism-assisted play (piece registration, capture trays); the ONLY arm with real sales data
classic-reborn.prior_note: Seed this arm's Beta prior at alpha=3,beta=2 (2 real sales before Bob existed). Lane=edition: novelty gate checks the EDITION is original vs existing sets; rules must be public-domain classics only, never a modern copyrighted game.

wildcard.hook: matches no known family — the exploration reserve; never let exploration hit zero
